build_faiss_flat_index: build a FAISS flat index from candidate entity encodings and save to disk
build_faiss_hnsw_index: build a FAISS HNSW index from candidate entity encodings for faster inference
run_build_faiss_index: run the CLI to build a FAISS index from a torch encoding file
review_main_function: review the main function that loads encodings and builds a FAISS index
refactor_index_selection: refactor the main function to support additional FAISS index types beyond flat and HNSW
